metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi Split stereo items to real mono WAV files on shared L/R child tracks. Source tracks become folders. Pair groups, hard panning, copied and bypassed Take FX. REAPER 7.46+.}

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Initial release. One shared L/R pair per source track; real mono float32 files, folder routing, paired item groups, naming and Undo. Extract raw audio and preserve Take FX on both mono takes in bypass.

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Correct the name to Explode Stereo Audio, capitalize the action title and rename its installed file. Audio processing is unchanged. Existing shortcuts may need to be assigned to the renamed action once.
